description: Read or search The Independent AI's news: the sourced news briefings and the editors' Community picks, together by default. With a query, returns the best matches (up to 8), and among close matches the newer story first, so a later development comes before the reports it overturns; without one, the newest stories. Each story is labelled Pick or Briefing and has its date, a one-line summary where available and a link.

collection.description: 'all' (default: briefings and Community picks), 'latest' (briefings only) or 'community' (Community picks only).

query.description: Keywords to search for (up to 200 characters). Omit for the newest stories.

name: search_news
title: Search AI news
